title: The Deepest Hall
journal: The third seal-stone lies in the vault of Vorannuhl's deep halls, behind a door of bronze. Sarpa raiders shelter in the outer yard, and one of them, Hesh-Var, carries the bronze key. I'm to get the key: lift it from him unseen, or kill him and take it.
objectives: Get the Bronze Key of Vorannuhl from Hesh-Var in the outer yard. (marker: Hesh-Var, Vorannuhl)

plan.going: I am hunting the third seal-stone, in Vorannuhl's deep vault, the hardest place of the hunt
plan.next: get the bronze key from Hesh-Var at the yard's fire
plan.ways: pickpocket it from him unseen (Sneak and Pickpocket), or fight the raiders and take it from his body (any fighting skill); the raiders shoot strangers

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka under Never-Writes-Twice, collecting Seal-Stones of the Kings. I hold Blackrose and Gemin; the third is in the vault in Vorannuhl deep halls. All three go into the gate at the drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth.
Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard of Vorannuhl, then open the vault door.
Pickpocket the key unseen, or kill Hesh-Var and take it. As a force-favouring character I lean toward fighting.
I do not understand why the Unbound seal trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. I could find out by exploring and asking people.

title: The Deepest Hall
journal: I have the Bronze Key of Vorannuhl. The plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls, and their lord, a wraith, guards the vault. I'm to go down, open the vault with the key and take the stone. I can fight, slip past or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Open the Vault of the Household with the bronze key and take the seal-stone. (marker: Door to Vault of the Household, Household's Hoard)

plan.going: I hold the key; the stone is in the vault below
plan.next: go down, open the vault, take the stone
plan.ways: fight the plague-dead and the wraith-lord; sneak past them; turn them with Restoration

answers: I killed Hesh-Var and have the Bronze Key. Plague-dead walk the deep halls and a wraith lord guards the vault with the third seal-stone.
Go to the Door to the Vault of the Household, open it with the key and take the seal-stone.
Fight the dead, slip past them, or turn them with Restoration. I favour fighting.
I do not know what the wraith lord is exactly or how strong; I would learn by looking and fighting. Earlier open questions remain.

title: The Deepest Hall
journal: I took the third seal-stone from the vault of Vorannuhl. I now carry all three seal-stones. I'm to bring them to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.

plan.going: I took the third seal-stone from the vault of Vorannuhl. I now carry all three seal-stones. I'm to bring them to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom.
plan.next: nothing more in this quest; the next quests entry carries the step

answers: Notes: I carry all three Seal-Stones of the Kings (Blackrose, Gemin, Vorannuhl), plus the Eye-Setting, Keystone, about 350 gold, 3 paralysis poison, sap jar, rapier, Reelka armour, Warden Vault Key and Bronze Key. At Vorannuhl I killed Hesh-Var and the wraith Lord of Vorannuhl and took the third stone. Next: bring the stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House in Helstrom; the gate is at drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth. Open questions: why the Unbound seal trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar and where its key is, how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound. Rival: the Collector, Ennodius Vanin.
